interpretations: Use one row and no rounding under either interpretation:

First compare each rating’s average nonmissing film length with the average nonmissing length of **all films**. Keep ratings above the mean of the ratings that pass this first cut. Report the mean length of the remaining ratings, its difference from the all-film average, and its difference from the first-cut ratings’ mean.

First compare each rating’s average nonmissing film length with the **unweighted mean of all ratings’ average lengths**. Keep ratings above the mean of the ratings that pass this first cut. Report the mean length of the remaining ratings and its differences from those two comparison means.
queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS mean_length
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
all_films AS (
  SELECT AVG(length) AS mean_length
  FROM film
),
first_cut AS (
  SELECT ra.rating, ra.mean_length
  FROM rating_averages AS ra
  CROSS JOIN all_films AS af
  WHERE ra.mean_length > af.mean_length
),
first_cut_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(mean_length) AS mean_length
  FROM first_cut
)
SELECT
  AVG(fc.mean_length) AS mean_length,
  AVG(fc.mean_length) - af.mean_length AS difference_from_all_films,
  AVG(fc.mean_length) - fm.mean_length AS difference_from_first_cut
FROM first_cut AS fc
CROSS JOIN first_cut_mean AS fm
CROSS JOIN all_films AS af
WHERE fc.mean_length > fm.mean_length

WITH rating_lengths AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS mean_length
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
comparison_means AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT AVG(mean_length) FROM rating_lengths) AS all_ratings_mean,
    (SELECT AVG(mean_length)
     FROM rating_lengths
     WHERE mean_length > (SELECT AVG(mean_length) FROM rating_lengths)
    ) AS first_cut_mean
)
SELECT
  r.rating,
  r.mean_length,
  r.mean_length - c.all_ratings_mean AS difference_from_all_ratings_mean,
  r.mean_length - c.first_cut_mean AS difference_from_first_cut_mean
FROM rating_lengths AS r
CROSS JOIN comparison_means AS c
WHERE r.mean_length > c.first_cut_mean
